# Fact: Coffee Preference

## Statement

Alex drinks black coffee, no milk or sugar.

## Context

Alex's morning routine starts with a cup of black coffee.
The preference is for filter coffee or Aeropress brewed at home.
Alex avoids milk, cream, and sugar in coffee.
On average, Alex drinks two cups of black coffee per day.
